description: COACTUPC's happy read chain for account 00000000001 - the record-contract baseline of this folder, and the case that owns gates G45, G19, G21 and the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm of G47. THE PATH. EIBCALEN is the full 1033 bytes that COMMON-RETURN :1010-1018 returns - 160 for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus 873 for WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false too: the ELSE at :887-892 restores both areas from DFHCOMMAREA and nothing is re-initialised. The carried CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1, which is exactly what the cold start of case01 left, and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives in its ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED state - LOW-VALUES or a space per the 88 at :656-658. AID: DFHENTER, NOT DFHPF12, and the choice is forced by the source rather than preferred. The validity gate at :906-912 accepts PF12 only in the conjunction (CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND NOT ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) at :910, so with the details unfetched PF12 is PFK-INVALID and :914-916 REMAPS it to CCARD-AID-ENTER before the dispatch ever sees it. A case that declared PF12 here would therefore be asserting an arm the program cannot be on; the natural trigger for ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is ENTER on the re-entry turn, and 2000-DECIDE-ACTION reaches the very same body either way because WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2568 and WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 at :2572 SHARE one statement block. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 - arms :927 CCARD-AID-PFK03, :964 ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, :966 CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-MENUPGM AND NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, :979 ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, :980 ACUP-CHANGES-FAILED, :996 OTHER - lands on WHEN OTHER, because the context is REENTER and not ENTER. That arm performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1433-1449 edits ONLY the search key while the details are unfetched: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT runs, then :1438 MOVEs LOW-VALUES to ACUP-OLD-ACCT-DATA and :1446 GO TOes the exit, so not one other field is edited and no field is flagged. 1210 :1801-1817 finds ACCTSIDI numeric and non-zero, MOVEs it to CDEMO-ACCT-ID and SETs FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID, which is the guard 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's first arm tests at :2573 before SETting WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :2574 and performing 9000-READ-ACCT at :2575. THE READ CHAIN, all three reads DFHRESP(NORMAL) (gate G47, NORMAL arm). 9000-READ-ACCT :3610-3643 INITIALIZEs ACUP-OLD-DETAILS, SETs WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE, MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID to ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID and WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID, then runs the guard chain. 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT :3654-3662 READs DATASET(LIT-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH) = CXACAIX with RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) INTO(CARD-XREF-RECORD); its NORMAL arm :3665-3667 MOVEs XREF-CUST-ID to CDEMO-CUST-ID and XREF-CARD-NUM to CDEMO-CARD-NUM. GATE G45 IS THIS CASE'S: CXACAIX is an alternate-index PATH over the CCXREF base, never a second table - app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:63-65 defines it as ALTERNATE INDEX TO CCXREF VIA ACCOUNT KEY over CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH - so the one cardxref.txt seed serves both access paths and there is no separate cross-reference-by-account dataset in inputs. 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT :3703-3711 READs DATASET(LIT-ACCTFILENAME) = ACCTDAT INTO(ACCOUNT-RECORD), NORMAL arm :3714-3715 SETs FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER. 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST :3753-3761 READs DATASET(LIT-CUSTFILENAME) = CUSTDAT with RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X) INTO(CUSTOMER-RECORD), NORMAL arm :3764-3765 SETs FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER - which is what :2577-2579 tests before SETting ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS. 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA :3805-3883 then publishes the commarea, INITIALIZEs ACUP-OLD-DETAILS and copies the record in, and two details of that copy are behaviour rather than style. First, the five monetary fields go into the -N REDEFINES views - ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N and its siblings at :676-707, each PIC S9(10)V99 over a 12-byte PIC X span. Second, the three account dates and the date of birth are copied COMPONENT-WISE into the 8-byte compact ACUP-OLD-OPEN-DATE, -EXPIRAION-DATE, -REISSUE-DATE and -CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD, all PIC X(08) at :684-701 and :746-751, by MOVE ACCT-OPEN-DATE(1:4)/(6:2)/(9:2) at :3832-3834 and the same shape at :3837-3839, :3843-3845 and :3857-3859. The whole-field alternatives are COMMENTED OUT at :3831, :3836, :3842 and :3856, which proves the compact form is deliberate; it is also the origin of the asymmetric offset pairing 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC later relies on. THE ACUP-OLD-DETAILS SNAPSHOT this leaves is therefore: ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID-X 00000000001, ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N 194.00, ACUP-OLD-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 2020.00, ACUP-OLD-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 1020.00, ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N 0.00, ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N 0.00 - every one at scale exactly 2 - with ACUP-OLD-OPEN-DATE 20141120, ACUP-OLD-EXPIRAION-DATE 20250520, ACUP-OLD-REISSUE-DATE 20250520 and ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD 19610608, each EIGHT unhyphenated bytes even though the record spans they came from are ten hyphenated ones, and the last of them named with hyphens it does not hold. Those values are stated here rather than pinned as a record because ACUP-OLD-DETAILS is not a dataset: it is WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, which COMMON-RETURN :1011-1013 places immediately after the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and this model compares that shared image only - ExpectedResponse.navigation admits CDEMO- names, ExpectedRecord.dataset admits a dataset binding key, and inventing either spelling for a working-storage area would assert against a layout no repository has. THE SCREEN, composed from the five rules 3000-SEND-MAP :2650-2661 applies. (1) 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2669 MOVEs LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO, then :2673-2690 assigns the six header items - TITLE01O and TITLE02O from the ACTIVE literals at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19 and :22, TRNNAMEO CAUP, PGMNAMEO COACTUPC, and CURDATEO mm/dd/yy with CURTIMEO hh:mm:ss from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE. (2) 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2700-2725 takes the ELSE because the context is REENTER, and because CC-ACCT-ID-N is not zero the ELSE at :2706-2707 MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO rather than the LOW-VALUES of :2705. (3) Its EVALUATE at :2710-2724 is order-sensitive and lands on WHEN ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :2715, not on the WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2711, because :2578 has already SET ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS - so 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES :2787-2864 paints forty-two data fields from ACUP-OLD-DETAILS while 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES, which would have left them all LOW-VALUES, is never performed. THE FIVE MONETARY ITEMS are the place a plausible translation goes wrong: :2797-2811 MOVEs each -N view through WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F PIC +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 at :371, a numeric-edited item with a FIXED leading sign, nine zero-suppressed integer positions whose insertion commas are suppressed with them, and TWO unsuppressed fraction 9s. So 194.00 renders as '+        194.00', 2020.00 as '+      2,020.00', 1020.00 as '+      1,020.00', and 0.00 as '+           .00' - eleven spaces then '.00', because the fraction positions are 9 and not Z and the all-suppressed blanking rule therefore does not apply. Each is exactly 15 characters, the width ACRDLIMI declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY. The dates arrive already split :2813-2823, the SSN is split by reference-modification at :2829-2831 into 020/97/3888, the two phone numbers by :2846-2857 into 908/119/8310 and 373/693/8684 - taking (2:3), (6:3) and (10:4) of the 13-character (NNN)NNN-NNNN form that occupies the first thirteen bytes of a 15-byte span - and ACSCITYO takes CUST-ADDR-LINE-3 at :2841 because address line three IS the city on this screen. ACSZIPCO is PIC X(5) where CUST-ADDR-ZIP is PIC X(10), so the MOVE at :2843 truncates on the RIGHT and the screen shows 12546: the field is narrower by design and is not widened here. AADDGRPO is ten spaces because the fixture's ACCT-GROUP-ID is ten spaces (practice B5 - the fixture is used exactly as it stands, however odd it looks, which is also why ACCT-ADDR-ZIP stays A000000000). (4) 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2957-2977 is order-sensitive too and lands on WHEN ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :2962, SETting PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES - WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) holding the 39-character literal at :470-471 - which :2979 MOVEs into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), right-space-padded to 45, note the trailing period; and :2981 MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75), still SPACES from :2574, into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) as 78 spaces. (5) FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:493-507 and are never assigned by the program at all. All fifty-four fields are assigned on this path, so not one is LOW-VALUES - which is precisely the difference between this case and case01. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES are unchanged from case01 and that is an assertion, not a copy. 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS does NOT leave early here: the guard at :3186-3189 exits only for ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK or FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK, and none holds, so all thirty-nine CSSETATY expansions from :3208 onwards do run - and every one of them is a no-op, because 3202 MOVEd LOW-VALUES to WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS at :2789 and each flag's NOT-OK is '0' and BLANK is 'B' or 'Y'/'N', so no test is true and no DFHRED and no '*' is written. Every colour is therefore the default DFHDFCOL and every highlight the default DFHDFHI, both x'00' exactly as MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO left them, except the information line, which 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3567-3571 sets bright with DFHBMASB because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false - there IS a message. FKEY05 and FKEY12 stay hidden: :3573-3576 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE and :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION, and the state is ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS with the change prompt. This is the OK half of the error-highlight matrix on a REENTER turn (gate G38): the context IS REENTER, so CSSETATY's guard is satisfied, and the reason nothing is red is that nothing failed - a materially stronger statement than case01's, where the guard itself was false. The xxxA items 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3496 and 3320-UNPROTECT-FEW-ATTRS :3502-3560 write are deliberately NOT declared: they are items of the INPUT redefine CACTUPAI, not of the sent CACTUPAO, and ScreenSend.attributes admits only the output planes whose names end in C, P, H or V. THE CURSOR is ACCTSIDL, reached by the LAST arm of an order-sensitive EVALUATE and not the first: at :3010 FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA is false because 3202 and 3250 left WS-INFO-MSG holding the change prompt rather than 'Details of selected account shown above'; at :3011 NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is false because WS-RETURN-MSG is SPACES; :3013-3014's filter arms are false because the flag is ISVALID; and every one of the thirty-odd non-key arms from :3017 to :3164 is false under LOW-VALUES - so WHEN OTHER at :3165-3166 MOVEs -1 TO ACCTSIDL. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor and ACCTSIDL is named for that reason rather than as a payload field. THE NEXT TARGET is COACTUPC / COACTUP / CACTUPA, and the nextProgram is the second difference from case01: this arm DOES perform 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, whose :1031-1033 MOVEs LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, -MAPSET and -MAP, where the fresh-entry arms reach 3400-SEND-SCREEN :3591-3592 and set only the last two. Termination is RETURN_TRANSID from :1015-1018, never XCTL: the only XCTL in this program is in the PF03 arm at :956-959, which this path does not reach. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload. Inbound it is screenRequest - the 1033-byte EIBCALEN, the AID, the sixteen carried CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields and ONE received map field. ACCTSIDI is the only one there can be: 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3496 protects all fifty input fields and :2996 then MOVEs DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA alone, so the prompt screen the previous turn sent left exactly one field enterable and a terminal has nothing else modified to return. Outbound it is the sixteen navigation fields, where 9500 has replaced CDEMO-CUST-ID with 000000001, the three customer names with Immanuel, Madeline and Kessler at their declared 25, CDEMO-ACCT-ID with 00000000001, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS with Y and CDEMO-CARD-NUM with 9680294154603697, while CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT stays 1 - this arm never re-SETs it - and CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, -FROM-PROGRAM, -TO-TRANID, -TO-PROGRAM, -USER-ID, -USER-TYPE, -LAST-MAP and -LAST-MAPSET stay exactly as they arrived, because only the PF03 arm at :944-950 writes them. NOTHING IS WRITTEN. COACTUPC's write verbs are the read-for-update and REWRITE pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING :3888-4105, which only the PF05 confirmation arm at :2602-2605 reaches, so expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion and each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel as the other half of it. THE RECORD CONTRACT is what this case exists to fix for cases 05-08 and 18-20, and it carries gates G19 and G21. Every record is pinned BOTH field by field and as a whole image, so the field names prove the decode and the image proves the total width - which is the only check that fails immediately when a FILLER is dropped, since a record missing one is short by exactly that span. ACCOUNT is 300 bytes: thirteen fields in app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy order, ending in FILLER PIC X(178) as 178 spaces, and including ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE spelled exactly as that copybook misspells it - correcting it to ACCT-EXPIRATION-DATE would leave the diff hunting a field the decoder never produces. CUSTOMER is 500 bytes: nineteen fields in app/cpy/CVCUS01Y.cpy order ending in FILLER PIC X(168) as 168 spaces. CARD-XREF is 50: three fields plus FILLER PIC X(14) as 14 spaces per app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy. CARD is 150 per app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, seeded so the slice is coherent and pinned unchanged, because this path never opens the card file. THE FIVE MONETARY FIELDS are stated as decimal literals at scale exactly 2 - 194.00, 2020.00, 1020.00, 0.00 and 0.00 (gate G23) - which FieldDiffer encodes through the same codec the implementation writes with and compares as BYTES; the record images alongside them carry the actual stored form, whose trailing '{' is the zoned positive overpunch for digit zero, so '00000001940{' is twelve characters denoting 194.00 in a PIC S9(10)V99 span. Never a double or a float (rule R4), and never HALF_UP or HALF_EVEN: ROUNDED appears zero times in COACTUPC and in all twenty-eight programs, so a store into a V99 receiver truncates - RoundingMode.DOWN - though no arithmetic is reached on this path at all, since the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 live in the part of 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS that :1446 skips. THE SEED. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER, so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16, risk R-F). Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. Row 48 of cardxref.txt and of carddata.txt are the cross-reference and the card for account 00000000001, and row 0 of acctdata.txt and custdata.txt are its account and its customer 000000001; every one of those four rows is a measured fact about the fixture rather than a convenient choice. RETURN CODE 0. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not occur anywhere in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. expectedMessages is empty, and that is a positive statement: every message write in this program is guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, :2574 SETs it off before the read, and all three reads took their NORMAL arm, so no DISPLAY line and no WS-MESSAGE is produced. The information text is not a message channel either - MessageChannel publishes DISPLAY_LINE, WS_MESSAGE_80 and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 and no 45-byte channel exists - so it is pinned byte-exactly where the program actually put it, in INFOMSGO at its declared 45, beside ERRMSGO at its declared 78. Every record image and every screen value here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never the platform default (practice B8). TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') in ABEND-ROUTINE :4203-4226 is unreachable on a path whose three reads all returned NORMAL. G51 is honoured by unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO: account.AccountUpdateController is constructed directly with fixture-backed repositories and its handler called as a plain method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path. PROVENANCE (practice B12). Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY: by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:371, :463-471, :640-756, :859-1020, :1429-1449, :1783-1822, :2562-2643, :2649-2729, :2787-2864, :2955-2983, :2986-3167, :3186-3211, :3441-3605, :3608-3648, :3650-3711, :3752-3765 and :3801-3884, and by DECODING the named fixture rows against the named copybook offsets - CVACT01Y 300, CVCUS01Y 500, CVACT03Y 50 and CVACT02Y 150 - cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the titles in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the file definitions in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:1-99, and the real data in app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt, custdata.txt, cardxref.txt and carddata.txt. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. TWO AUTHORING NOTES. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, this source revision's own timestamp - every file carries 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:5x CDT' - so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals and no wall clock can reach the expectation (practice B7). And COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, allocating its own case04 to a different scenario; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - the happy read chain of 9000 through 9500 with all three reads NORMAL - is what this case is specified to pin.
